title: rosa communis var. cinerosa
intro: Rosa communis var. cinerosa, commonly known as the cineraria rose, is a plant species in the rose family that is known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa communis var. cinerosa include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant, which can help to relieve symptoms of colds and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
